t.E174.agn: In 2016 EFSA could not assess its safety and did not set an ADI because there were no toxicity studies or particle size information.
t.E174.body: Silver ions are released from metallic silver, but the amount is unknown.
t.E174.eff.0.t: EFSA could not assess its safety because there were no toxicity studies or particle size information
t.E174.prod: Obtained by melting silver metal and dividing it into droplets, rolling and beating (mechanical processing).
t.E174.regx.0: Data insufficient; no ADI could be set.
t.E174.summary: Metallic silver; gives a silver colour. Used on the outer surface of cake decorations and confectionery.
